name: pagecast
description: Preview local HTML reports and static mini apps, then publish them to shareable URLs.

scripts.build: pnpm -C web install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm -C web run build
scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check src/publication-service.js && node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/mcp.js && node --check src/pagecast-home.js && node --check src/publication-context.js && node --check src/local-system.js && node --check src/markdown.js && node --check src/nameGenerator.js && node --check src/admin-security.js && node --check src/app-error.js && node --check src/wrangler-gateway.js && node --check src/path-token.js && node --check src/project-ref.js && node --check src/state-coordinator.js && node --check src/platform.js && node --check src/link-policy.js && node --check src/tunnel.js && node --check plugin/hooks/lib-path-token.mjs && node --check plugin/hooks/detect-report.mjs && node --check plugin/hooks/detect-artifacts-on-stop.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run check && npm test
